# NHCX Integrators

[Home](https://sandbox.abdm.gov.in/sandbox/v3) / [Documentation](https://sandbox.abdm.gov.in/sandbox/v3/new-documentation) / NHCX Integrators# National Health Claims Exchange (NHCX)

The National Health Claims Exchange (NHCX) is developed under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) by the National Health Authority (NHA) in consultation with Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI). With the primary purpose to streamline and standardize the processing of health insurance claims across the country, leveraging the Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) standards to ensure interoperability across diverse systems. This will enable automation and digitization of the claims process, reducing administrative costs and enhancing the overall experience.

# Domain Data Models

The domain data models include schema definitions for domain resources such as Claims, Providers, Payers, Policies, etc., and metadata specifications. These models are encoded using FHIR V4 and published by NRCES, CDAC. For more information, please refer to [this link](https://nrces.in/ndhm/fhir/r4/hcx-profile.html).
